M1E05-2: SELECT c1.category_name, COUNT(*) AS refund_cnt, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_total FROM fact_refund r JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id, p.category_id FROM fact_order_item i JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id) x ON x.order_id = r.order_id JOIN dim_category c2 ON c2.category_id = x.category_id JOIN dim_category c1 ON c1.category_id = c2.parent_category_id WHERE r.refund_reason = '商品质量问题' GROUP BY c1.category_id, c1.category_name
